author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman (as Charlotte Perkins Stetson)
title: The Yellow Wall Paper
edition: Wikisource validated transcription (Index: The Yellow Wall Paper.djvu) of Boston: Small, Maynard & Company, MCMI [1901] (copyright 1892 New England Magazine Corporation; copyright 1899 Small, Maynard & Company). The complete story is supplied across three nights. All nine word-level differences from Project Gutenberg's text were checked on a dated 1901 Small, Maynard scan (Internet Archive yellowwallpaper1901gilm), which confirms the Wikisource readings. Section spacing between journal entries is not marked; HTML presentation removed and whitespace normalized; the opening capitals ('IT is') are retained as transcribed. The library holds the story under its title heading; the title page, copyright and printer’s notices and the publisher’s reprint note are omitted.

rights.basis: Original English story first published in January 1892 (New England Magazine) and in book form by Small, Maynard in 1899; this 1901 printing was published before 1931, so its US term has expired as of 2026.

acquisition.method: MediaWiki parse API (action=parse, prop=text|revid) for the single Wikisource page The_Yellow_Wall_Paper (revision 15679493). Removed the Wikisource header, page-number anchors, licence footer and other no-export elements and everything before the story’s title; each HTML paragraph, and each run of text set directly in a section without a paragraph element, became a paragraph block with whitespace (including no-break spaces) collapsed to single spaces; small capitals kept as transcribed.
